name: Environment Variables
description: Inspect Default vs Current Environment Variable values, validate JSON configs, spot missing values, and safely update overrides.

name: Bulk Operations
description: Preview records with FetchXML and execute throttled bulk PATCH, state activation/deactivation, or DELETE operations safely under Host Security Gateway.

name: Record Inspector
description: Inspect all fields (including hidden attributes) on any Dataverse record by pasting a URL or GUID, edit updatable values, or jump to Access Diagnostics.

name: Row Counter
description: Count records across Dataverse tables (Total, Active, Inactive, Custom Filter) with HTTP headers inspection & CSV export.

name: Storage Analyzer
description: Identify Dataverse log and file storage bloat across AsyncOperations, Plugin Traces, Audits, Notes/Attachments, and Bulk Delete jobs.

name: Environment Timeline
description: Unified chronological activity and event timeline across Dataverse: Audits, Plugin Traces, Flow Runs, System Jobs, Solution Operations, and Sync Logs.

name: Plugin Trace Logs
description: Stream and filter Dataverse plugintracelog entries, trace full correlation cascades by depth, inspect stack traces, and spot slow plugins.

name: Table Automation Map
description: Unified view of every Plugin Step, Business Rule, Classic Workflow, Business Process Flow, Cloud Flow trigger, and Bound Custom API on any Dataverse table.

name: Plugin Step Manager
description: Browse registered Plugin Assemblies, Types, SDK Message Processing Steps, and Pre/Post Images, with 1-click step Enable/Disable.

name: Webhook Inspector
description: Inspect Dataverse Service Endpoints and Webhooks, linked SDK Message Processing Steps, recent Async delivery failures, and build sample RemoteExecutionContext payloads.

name: Connection Audit
description: Audit Connection References, map which Cloud Flows depend on each connection, and flag disconnected references or turned-off flows.

name: Flow Calendar
description: Visualise Power Automate cloud flow run history across a 7-day hourly timeline with response headers inspection.

name: Flow CodeView Reader
description: Decode Cloud Flow clientdata or Peek-Code JSON into a readable action tree by resolving OptionSet integer codes to labels and GUIDs to actual Dataverse record names.

name: Scheduled Flows
description: List all Scheduled Power Automate Cloud Flows by Solution with decoded recurrence timing, time zone, state, and a chronological Timeline view of upcoming runs.

name: ERD Visualizer
description: Select Dataverse tables to render an interactive pure-SVG Entity-Relationship diagram (1:N, N:1, N:N), export SVG, or copy Mermaid erDiagram.

name: Form & View XML
description: Audit FormXML JavaScript libraries, OnLoad/OnSave/OnChange handlers, tabs & fields, plus SavedQuery view layouts and FetchXML.

name: Label Explorer
description: Inspect localized Display Labels across all provisioned Dataverse languages (RetrieveProvisionedLanguages) for Tables and Columns, and export translation CSVs.

name: Schema Browser
description: Explore Dataverse EntityDefinitions, columns, OptionSet integer mappings, relationships, keys, and Global Option Sets.

name: FetchXML & Web API
description: Execute FetchXML queries (with paging & batch fallback) and OData Web API requests with table inspection, code generation, and CSV/JSON export.

name: Access Diagnostics
description: Diagnose effective record permissions via RetrievePrincipalAccess and inspect Security Roles, Team memberships, and record ownership.

name: Role Matrix
description: Compare Dataverse Security Role table privileges side-by-side (Create, Read, Write, Delete, Append, Assign, Share) and export security audit CSVs.

name: Solution Layers
description: Inspect managed vs Active unmanaged solution component layers (msdyn_componentlayer) and diagnose delete blockers via RetrieveDependenciesForDelete.
